anya-eng: Quick note: post-rollout telemetry shows a tiny surge in 502s for model-route llama3q on runtime 3.0 in ap-southeast. Not huge but correlated with SDK v4.0 canary.

leo-ops: saw that, digging logs. stack traces point to model binding during warmup.

tara-qa: Can reproduce on staging when mixing SDK v3.9 and v4.0 clients. Failing requests during long prompt warmup.

mike-rls: Deploybot, can we pin model=llama3q runtime=3.0 region=ap-southeast reason="interop sdk4.0" /deploybot pin region=ap-southeast model=llama3q runtime=3.0 reason=interop-sdk4.0

deploybot: @mike-rls acknowledged. Pin applied for ap-southeast: llama3q on runtime=3.0. (action=pb-9001)

anya-eng: Proposed temp mitigation: route new SDK v4.0 traffic to runtime=3.1 variant where binding fix exists, leave pin in place until we validate.

leo-ops: will open a narrow canary to runtime=3.1 for SDK4 traffic and run 30m smoke.

tara-qa: I'll run cross-SDK regression and post pass/fail. ETA 25m.

mike-rls: Update release notes + change window: add ap-southeast advisory. Tagging: @platform-team.

deploybot: Freeze remains until 1743224400 UTC or manual lift by @mike-rls.

anya-eng: Thanks. Keep updates here; if errors >0.5% for 10m we'll rollback routing entirely.
